name: grok-bot-marketplace
install: npm install && CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous npx convex dev --once

terminals.name: convex
terminals.description: Runs the local Convex backend and watches convex/ for changes. Uses anonymous agent mode so it needs no Convex account, and writes VITE_CONVEX_URL to .env.local.

terminals.name: vite
terminals.description: Runs the TanStack Start dev server on http://localhost:3000. Reads VITE_CONVEX_URL from .env.local. Clerk runs in keyless mode unless VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY/CLERK_SECRET_KEY are provided as secrets.
